ra.retained_audio_encoding: Full-length 48 kbps CBR Ogg Opus (lossy); original pilot MP3 also preserved
ra.scope: 106 complete published Lightly Edited texts. Audio counts are segments, not continuous tapes. The finite original-audio frame has 2,620 links. Historical missing/overwritten recordings are not reconstructed.
ra.auxiliary_scope: Separate local conversion-test copy of source1.0, outside canonical source/file/duration totals.

bashar.retained_audio_encoding: Publisher audio encodings; formats and editions recorded separately
bashar.scope: 19 retained mixed-context recordings plus official public publications. The Vimeo frame has 307 IDs and 87 advertised at least five minutes; actual decoded duration determines admission. Unique audio sources here means publication IDs, while exact encoded-audio families are reported separately. Excerpts, greetings and promotions are not full paid sessions. Counts do not cover every historic Bashar upload. No count cap in this new study.

scope: Dated receipt-based collection snapshot. The frozen primary statistical study remains 106 Ra sessions and 19 Bashar-related contexts. New acquisitions have separate analysis coverage.

figures.caption: Top: summed decoded durations of retained Ra segments per canonical session; source gaps and missing historical recordings are not filled. Bottom: each admitted Bashar publication is a point, using retained-media duration metadata and grouped by source format; black marks show medians. Official excerpts are not full sessions. The logarithmic duration axis exposes the recording-length difference; this is acquisition metadata, not speech-rate or content analysis.
